_comment: The porting ledger for D-312: which of the Python server's 161 tools this Rust
server has taken over. `tests/parity.rs` checks the live server's advertised set
against this list in BOTH directions, and checks every name here is a tool the
golden corpus actually has — so a tool cannot be silently dropped, silently added,
or listed here under a name that never existed.
Add a name here in the same commit that lands its tool, never before.
